column2: This power... this very power is the proof that we shall rule over all!
The name of god exists for us...
Learn your place, arrogant angel.
But... we know the mercy of a king...
The great mercy that only the noble possess.
Angel, do you not wish to save this hero's soul?
Come to us as a messenger of the new god, and I shall forget all you have done and save you and this hero.
Having touched our great power, you understand now, do you not? Which side is right, and which is wrong.
Now, answer.
Will you serve us, or be devoured by the Heavenly Dragon along with this hero and vanish?
I understand...
No...
...Yes... I understand... I will become your messenger...
Please... save her soul, save her life...
Heh, splendid. A fine spirit...
Then... I shall save this hero...
Cecia!!!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha! Yes! That look... the look of your despair...
I wanted to see that face, the face of one who has lost everything!
Truly, the foolishness of you angels is beyond saving...
Now, I'll put you inside the dragon together with your hero...
Die.
No... I am an angel... I cannot sell my soul to a devil...
She believed in me, an angel, and fought for me. I will not let you use her soul or mine.
Hmph, what impertinence...
Very well.
You too shall die and become balm for Lord Satan's soul.
Wait, Beelzebub...
You call me by my true name...
How could I forget those red eyes of yours, or your filthy tricks...
That voice... this aura!!
It's been a long time, Lord of the Flies.
Michael! Raphael!
Forgive me for being late, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
I knew that a day like this would come when Satan's dragon was revived...
And how great the power of the fallen angel lurking in the shadows was...
We can't leave Beelzebub and Satan's Heavenly Dragon to you alone.
Let's defeat them together.
Now, hero, rise again.
...Light?
Hero of the world below, show the devil the strength of humans once more.
No matter how many of you gather, this human can never defeat me!
Last Battle (lose)
...Ngh, Lord Satan's soul... has come to this...
This is justice, Beelzebub.
Hmph, what are you saying... Don't get cocky... over something like this...
For now, I shall withdraw... But one day, Lord Satan will surely be revived...
And he will lead the demon armies and burn your Heavens to the ground...
...Lord Satan, I will revive you without fail... Together we shall pass through the gates of the Heavens...
Wait for it... angels...
Zombie & Ghoul
I have no name to give a monster.
Here I come!!
Ngh, a hunter... You...
I have questions for you.
Do you know Ravenruft?
The name of our king... How could I not know it?
...I see... your scent... your air...
Why do you, who inherit the king's blood, side with humans...
Where is he... Where is he?
If you want to go to the king's castle, go north...
But I doubt you'll ever reach it...
Our king would never let a traitor like you live...
I am... human...
Clive-sama... Will that terrible vampire come again?
Say... Clive-sama?
Clive-sama...
Gorgon
Heh heh, turning down an invitation from such a beautiful woman... You're a failure as a man.
It seems you've gone somewhere you can't come back from.
Yes, that's right.
I offered myself to Lord Ravenruft of my own will.
For him, who grants eternal life and beauty... I would do anything...
You who oppose the king... I shall dispose of you here.
Vampire
Hmm... It seems the gift from your father was wasted.
Who are you?
My name is Blas. I've come to see you as the king's messenger.
But... to think the child from that time would grow so big.
I thought you'd died in a ditch somewhere.
What?
You wouldn't remember, I suppose.
When we attacked your village, you were the only one I let go.
It was you!!!
Ugh... ngh!
Ha ha ha ha, it seems you're weaker to the urge of anger than to the lure of sweet blood.
But that is the greatness of the king's blood.
